systems.owner: Gendarmerie nationale de Djibouti; the replacement wholly financed by France's DCSD
systems.tiers: the brigade d'investigations criminelle of the Section de Recherches et de Documentation; the file set up in 2004 is called obsolete and a new one was due to be installed in 2022

note: No fact: the fiche names no system in which brigades record reports or cases; it gives the gendarmerie's territorial brigades (13 listed in seven companies, a further Balbala brigade begun in September 2021) and four police commissariats at Tadjourah, Obock, Ali-Sabieh and Dikhil, with only a fingerprint file as an information system.
